name: Kubernetes node load — every k3s node's CPU, memory, disk, network and requests
description: Per-node load and utilization of the k3s cluster (poweredge-xubuntu, gmktec-xubuntu, hp-xubuntu): CPU busy and cores, memory against capacity, pressure conditions, filesystem, network, requests and limits against allocatable, and pod usage by node and namespace. Defined as code in livespec-dev-tooling ci-runner/observability/boards/k8s-node-load.json and converged by apply-boards.sh; edit the definition, never this board in the UI. text_panel.content:
# Kubernetes node load

Every k3s node's load and utilization in one page: **poweredge-xubuntu** (server), **gmktec-xubuntu** (agent), **hp-xubuntu** (factory-only agent). Kubelet rows (`k8s.node.*`, `k8s.pod.*`) are scraped for EVERY node by the poweredge collector through the API server and carry `k8s.node.name`; `host.name` on them names the node the row is about. Host rows (`system.*`) come from a collector on each node, by `host.name`.

**CPU busy is read as `1 - idle`, not from load average** (see `.ai/ci-node-capacity-reads.md`: load counts runnable and D-state tasks, not busy cores). Memory headroom is kubelet's own eviction signal: working set over working set + `memory.available`.

**This board is code**: `ci-runner/observability/boards/k8s-node-load.json` in `thewoolleyman/livespec-dev-tooling`, converged by `apply-boards.sh`. Triggers beside it in `../triggers/k8s-node-*.json`. Plan `kubernetes-node-observability` (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil).

annotation.name: Node CPU idle fraction (1 - busy) by node
annotation.description: AVG of system.cpu.utilization where state=idle, per host.name: the mean idle fraction across the node's CPUs. 0.10 is 90% busy, the saturation trigger's threshold. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Kubelet node CPU usage (cores) by node
annotation.description: MAX of k8s.node.cpu.usage (cores in use, from the kubelet stats summary) per k8s.node.name. Compare with the node's CPU count: poweredge 72, gmktec 32, hp 16. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Node memory working set / capacity by node
annotation.description: MAX of working_set / (working_set + memory.available) per k8s.node.name — kubelet's memory.available IS capacity minus working set, so this is the eviction signal as a fraction. 0.90 is the memory trigger's threshold. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Node pressure conditions and Ready by node
annotation.description: MAX of k8s.node.condition_ready, _memory_pressure, _disk_pressure, _pid_pressure per k8s.node.name (1 = condition true). Ready should read 1 and every pressure 0. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Kubelet node filesystem usage and capacity by node
annotation.description: MAX of k8s.node.filesystem.usage and k8s.node.filesystem.capacity (bytes, the kubelet's root/imagefs view) per k8s.node.name. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Pod network traffic by node and direction
annotation.description: SUM of k8s.pod.network.io (bytes, cumulative counter; Honeycomb applies the increase per bucket) per k8s.node.name and direction. The kubelet on these nodes emits no node-level network series (its stats summary reports per-interface counters only), so node-level traffic is the host network panel below. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: CPU requests and limits against allocatable by node
annotation.description: SUM of k8s.container.cpu_request and k8s.container.cpu_limit across containers, beside MAX of k8s.node.allocatable_cpu, per k8s.node.name (cores). Requests over allocatable means the scheduler is full; usage far under requests means reservations are idle. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Memory requests and limits against allocatable by node
annotation.description: SUM of k8s.container.memory_request and k8s.container.memory_limit across containers, beside MAX of k8s.node.allocatable_memory, per k8s.node.name (bytes). Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Pod CPU usage by node and namespace
annotation.description: SUM of k8s.pod.cpu.usage (cores) per k8s.node.name and k8s.namespace.name — which namespace (factory, arc-runners, gates, ...) is loading which node. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Pod memory working set by node and namespace
annotation.description: SUM of k8s.pod.memory.working_set (bytes) per k8s.node.name and k8s.namespace.name. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Host load average (1m) by node
annotation.description: MAX of system.cpu.load_average.1m per host.name. Read beside the idle panel, never alone: load counts D-state and runnable tasks, so a large load at high idle is not saturation. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Host filesystem used bytes by node and mount
annotation.description: MAX of system.filesystem.usage where state=used per host.name and mountpoint (hostmetrics, df-style). Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.

annotation.name: Host network I/O by node and direction
annotation.description: SUM of system.network.io (bytes, hostmetrics, cumulative counter) per host.name and direction across the node's interfaces — the node-level network traffic the kubelet does not report. Emitters: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml (k8s_cluster + one kubeletstats per node through the API server, on poweredge-xubuntu) and the per-node host collectors (config.ci-runner-host.yaml, config.k3s-agent-host.yaml, config.hp-factory.yaml), converged by livespec-dev-tooling ansible/ci-pool.yml.
